artifacts.summary: Eight-phase migration retiring routing_agents_hard for hard_contracts across books, cslib and lean: wire and demonstrate per-domain contract injection first (fixing a live basename clobber), then remove the routing block and its resolution rung, then retire twelve unreachable wrapper files and converge the ~50 rosters, tests and docs that name them.

memory_candidates.content: In this agent-system, deleting an extension agent or skill file is never a one-file change: six roster arrays inside lint/lint-agent-contracts.sh log_fail on a rostered agent path that does not exist, lint/collapsed-blocks/registry.tsv pins specific agent files as collapsed-block exemplars (with a matching .txt fixture named after the file), check-extension-docs.sh Rule A fails on a skill directory absent from provides.skills and orphan detection fails in the reverse direction, and index-entries.json load_when.agents arrays plus opencode-agents.json carry per-agent rows. Before planning any agent/skill retirement, grep the full source store for the file's basename and read lint-agent-contracts.sh's roster arrays -- the reference surface is routinely an order of magnitude larger than the files being deleted.
